title: Siman 227
section: His Journey and Residence in Uman

segments.he: שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ אָז בִּימֵי נְעוּרָיו בְּעֵת
segments.en: (43.) I heard from Rabbi Naftali that he said to him before Rosh Hashana in Uman: "Behold, a great and awesome mountain approaches — but I do not know whether we are going toward the mountain or the mountain is coming toward us."
